job.job_description:
Job Title AI Engineer
Location Bangalore (5 Days a Week from the Office)
Interview Mode- Video
Duration: Full Time
NP: Immediate joiner only
Qualification: B.E / B.Tech or equivalent degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field
Must have skills:
3 5 years of hands-on experience in designing, building, and deploying production-grade AI/ML solutions
Proficiency in Python, PySpark, SQL, and ML libraries like Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM
Cloud-native ML development experience on AWS (SageMaker) , GCP (Vertex AI) , or Azure ML
Strong background in NLP/GenAI frameworks : Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex
Practical knowledge of MLOps tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) and deployment frameworks (Fast API, Flask, Docker, Kubernetes)
Hands-on experience with Vector Databases
Familiarity with SQL Coder, Text-to-SQL models.
Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and team collaboration skills
job.location: New Delhi, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG, LangGraph, FastAPI, AWS experience; transferable cloud skills; meets core AI/GenAI requirements.
